title: Recovery spin
coachNotes: Day after Resegone (load 162, 1319m of descent). ATL 53 against CTL 33, TSB -20. This is decay, not training: zero impact, nothing above Z1. Garmin target 30-40. ITB check on waking before anything else: single-leg squat, direct pressure on the lateral epicondyle at 30 degrees flexion, descending stairs. Any of the three positive and today is off entirely.
